_meta.purpose: Draft ledger for model re-tier proposals (Phase 48). DRAFT-ONLY: nothing reads this file to change a model pin; no code path in Phase 48 applies a proposal. Applying is out of scope - when it ever ships, applying a pin swap is the one interaction that requires an explicit yes from the human.
_meta.written_by: token-cost-monitor stages drafts as .claude/telemetry/retier-*.draft.json; sessionend-cost-proposals.sh folds staged drafts into the proposals array below at the SessionEnd seam (BATCH-AT-SEAMS). Humans edit status by hand after review; 'approved' records a decision, it does not trigger anything.

entry_schema.status: draft | approved | rejected (human-edited; entries always ENTER as draft)

proposed_change.component: path of the agent/helper whose pin would change, e.g. .claude/agents/01_research/research-helper.md

entry_schema.evidence: array of strings - mechanical evidence only: measured telemetry (session ids + fields), published pricing (model-pricing.json entry + as_of), actual runs (command + output). Model self-assessment is banned as an evidence source (see token-cost-monitor).
